tax.text: He supported tax reform that lowered rates for families and small businesses.
tax.quote: I am thrilled we passed pro-growth tax reform which will benefit low- and middle-income earners.

wages.text: He voted against the Raise the Wage Act and said raising the minimum wage would eliminate jobs.
wages.quote: Raising the minimum wage would eviscerate millions of jobs.

trade.text: He voted for trade negotiating legislation and said agreements could expand markets for American products.
trade.quote: we can negotiate a free and fair trade agreement to expand markets for U.S.-made goods.

schools.text: He said students in failing schools should have school choice, including private school opportunities.
schools.quote: I believe that school choice initiatives should be available to children who are trapped in bad schools.

safety.text: He introduced a bill to support community threat assessment efforts intended to prevent violence before attacks occur.
safety.quote: This bipartisan bill will save lives by focusing efforts on prevention rather than simply reaction, because once the first shot is fired, it is too late.

immigration.text: He called for enforcing borders, ending catch and release, and deporting criminal aliens.
immigration.quote: It is imperative we keep our promise to the American people to build the wall and enforce our borders by utilizing new technology and supporting our law enforcement agencies.

guns.text: He said he supports gun owners’ rights and backed legislation for interstate concealed carry and firearm transport.
guns.quote: I am fully committed to supporting the Second Amendment as a protected right guaranteed to individuals in the U.S. Constitution.

abortion.text: He said he is committed to advancing a pro-life agenda and introduced a bill to bar COVID relief funds from covering abortions.
abortion.quote: As someone with strong pro-life convictions and a Member of the House Pro-Life Caucus, I am committed to advancing a pro-life agenda.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: He voted for the American Health Care Act and advocated for insurance sales across state lines and more consumer choice.
health.quote: I promised the people of the 36th District of Texas that I would repeal Obamacare and replace it with a workable, affordable solution which lowers premiums while protecting those with preexisting conditions.

energy.text: He supported affordable domestic energy production and opposed regulations he said burden refineries and petrochemical plants.
energy.quote: Providing reliable, affordable energy that powers our country and the world is what Texas does best.

voting.text: He voted for the SAVE Act, which he said would ensure only U.S. citizens can vote in federal elections.
voting.quote: This legislation ensures that only U.S. citizens can vote in federal elections.

abortion.text: She says she will defend abortion rights and work to codify Roe v. Wade.
abortion.quote: In Congress, I’ll fight to defend a woman’s right to choose and work to pass federal laws to codify Roe v. Wade.
